ui_label: Horizontal grid cell with a plane projection grid type and 4 x 4 km resolution.
description: Regular 4 km × 4 km Cartesian cell-centre grid for the CISM Greenland configuration using the EPSG:3413 polar stereographic projection (WGS84). The grid consists of 416 × 704 cell centres and is used for scalar and mass-related variables, such as ice thickness, temperature, surface elevation, and surface mass balance. The projection has a latitude of origin of 90°N, a standard parallel of 70°N, a central meridian of 45°W, and zero false easting and northing. All grid cells, including masked cells where no ice-sheet calculation is performed, are included in the horizontal domain.
